name: ELC Bookmarks
source: This repo's printed bookmarks + phonics tracker (app.js BOOKMARK_LEVELS / GRAPHEMES)
notes: teaches lists every sound app.js's own GRAPHEMES sounds[] taught for each grapheme, in the same order, so the data-bank-driven trainer reproduces app.js's grapheme-answer screens (dot counts, sound-alike matching) exactly for this sequence.

units.label: Level 6
units.notes: ch is one of app.js's multi-sound graphemes (chop/school/chef) — all 3 sounds included. th's second (voiced, 'this') sound is th.dh.

units.label: Level 7
units.notes: wh mapped to phonemes.json's /w/ (not the app.js-notation 'hw') per phonemes.json's explicit note that wh is taught as a /w/ grapheme.

units.label: Level 8
units.notes: ed and oo are app.js multi-sound graphemes — all sounds included. ed.ed stands for the /ĕd/ sound (landed) = phonemes ["e","d"]; it is not a single phoneme id — see NEEDED_GPCS.md.

units.label: Level 9
units.notes: ea and ow are app.js multi-sound graphemes — all sounds included.

units.label: Level 11
units.notes: ie and ei are app.js multi-sound graphemes (chief/pie/parties, receive/veil/forfeit) — all sounds included.

units.label: Level 12
units.notes: ou and ew are app.js multi-sound graphemes (round/shoulder/you/famous, grew/new) — all sounds included. app.js's 'ear' grapheme entry is unusual: its only listed sound is /er/ via the example 'early', not the far more common NEAR-vowel reading (hear/near) that most phonics programs teach for 'ear' — kept as-is for fidelity to app.js; see accuracy caveats.

units.label: Level 13
units.notes: ough is an app.js multi-sound grapheme — all 6 sounds included. ough.uf (rough) and ough.off (cough) are composite ids standing for phoneme pairs ["u","f"] and ["o","f"] — see NEEDED_GPCS.md. ui and ey are also app.js multi-sound graphemes (fruit/nuisance; they/key) — all sounds included. app.js listed a third ey sound, /igh/, on the example 'donkey' — donkey ends in /ee/ like monkey, so that reading was wrong and has been dropped.

units.label: Level 14
units.notes: si is an app.js multi-sound grapheme (session/vision) — both sounds included.
